news.title: What’s the real cost of non-refundable deposits?
news.summary_en:
After UK visa rejection rates soared over the winter, thousands of students from countries like Pakistan and Bangladesh are now being told their tuition fee deposits are non-refundable. The PIE investigates the scale of the problem and how refund policies are being communicated by universities and agents.

Hear insights from Nicholas Cuthbert on what this means for students.
news.author: Nicholas Cuthbert

news.title: DHS walks back green card guidance
news.summary_en: The US administration has partially walked back recent guidance that instructed most people seeking permanent residency to apply for a green card outside the US.
news.author: Polly Nash

news.title: Job cuts mount across UK universities amid financial strain
news.summary_en: Redundancies continue to sweep the UK higher education sector as mounting financial pressures force universities to implement cost-cutting measures.
news.author: Kim Martin

news.title: UK universities flying blind as visa refusals force admissions rethink
news.summary_en: University leaders in the UK have warned that institutions are increasingly making high-stakes admissions and compliance decisions without enough shared data, as visa refusals, rising student costs and recruitment pressures reshape international recruitment strategies.
news.author: Amy Baker

news.title: Rising travel costs add to uncertainty ahead of September student arrivals
news.summary_en: Institutions are preparing for rising airfares and potential travel disruption ahead of key student intakes, while students and families navigate visa delays and broader affordability pressures.
news.author: Abhishek Nair

news.title: Home Office issues amendment after The PIE reports on BCA blind spot
news.summary_en: The Home Office has published an amendment to the student sponsor compliance policy, clarifying that only visa refusal decisions that are successfully overturned by administrative review will be exempt from BCA calculations.
news.author: Nicholas Cuthbert

news.title: Barney Glover appointed inaugural chief commissioner of Australia’s tertiary watchdog
news.summary_en: Australia's new tertiary education watchdog is beginning to take shape, with former university leader Barney Glover appointed inaugural chief commissioner, alongside three statutory commissioners tasked with driving major sector reforms.
news.author: Kim Martin

news.title: US sector hails growing congressional support despite headwinds
news.summary_en: While strong policy headwinds remain, US experts have welcomed signs of a gradual shift in Washington DC as Congress increasingly stands up for international education.
news.author: Polly Nash

news.title: New UKVI compliance metrics for universities take effect today
news.summary_en: Highly anticipated and controversial new compliance requirements for UK universities come into force today, with immigration specialists warning the measures could have "potentially devastating consequences" for institutions that fail to meet increasingly stringent benchmarks.
news.author: Kim Martin
